text: not as the ad described. I downloaded it based on an ad and so far, despite the promises in the ad that it was showing actual gameplay this does not appear to be the case. I enjoy a match game so the two stars are for that but I despise flat out lies. I will give it a few more levels to see if what the ad promised materialises but otherwise I will be deleting as I already have the same format games. Disappointed.

Very disappointing, as game is very unlike what is advertised. The latest ads state theyre promising game which is advertised is the real thing but sadly it isnt. Instead of mostly being about saving mother & child from freezing temperatures, majority of game is based on merging garden items on a fairytale island. Rewards from those clear-the-board games are small, and its not long before gems & currency run out, after which you need to purchase via real money.

False advertising. The game is nothing like the trailer. I've been playing this game for ages. It's a merging game. 1 star review due to the misleading advert. Editing this review to say that the adverts are still a total misrepresentation of what the game actually is. it's a match 3 merging game. Why advertise it as something it's not, people will just uninstall when they realise the game is nothing like what is advertised.

Yet another game that tries to prise its way into your wallet. it's soooooo slow moving if you dont use actual cash money. Of course spending money isn't mandatory, but if you dont intend to do that, dont bother playing. Oooh and you wont actually get to play the story game you thought you were downloading instead at (very) best 95% of your time will be playing matching games and they become very dull very quickly.

I play this game, and its nothing like the ads, so dont be taken in, its a typical long winded game thats always after your money, most predictable game i have ever played as it always leaves you hanging, needed that one more move to finish the level, the further you get the more stressfull and boring it gets, good game if you got plenty of money you want to waste.

I'm frustrated with this game. I have made friends, but it won't let me go to my friends' islands to dig treasure. Tried to get help through support, but I can't even leave them a message to complain about the fault or glitch as there seems to be a problem with that also. My game and friends game are up to date as all of them are playing. I don't want to delete game then restart game to find I've lost my progress. Please help sort this. Ty.

Brilliant game,the graphics are excellent, and the game play is easy on the earlier levels but does get harder. My only bugbear is when I started this game, it had a mini game, and that has disappeared. Now, I can not get big diamonds to merge. Overall, it's fantastic. Big but, If you haven't got all your extras for certain levels you've got no chance and then it let's you win when you've got 1 life left....

I've just reduced from 5 to 1 star: The magic merging crystals, the best part of the game, have been eliminated by the developers. I am so frustrated as without them progress is diminished by probably 90%. It's taken the main fun and rewarding element out of the game. I've worked hard for over a year to get where I am now but now that has been taken away from the players. I contacted support but of no use. It's so disappointing and frustrating.

It looks good and it's easy to become hooked. There are no ads, as stated (which is great), but it's easy to spend a fortune on this game. Refreshing all your "lives" costs 900 diamonds; equally however, buying 5 extra moves costs 900; luring players to buy more moves for actual cash or wait far too long for one free life. It does offer free episodes of play (15mins up to 3 hours), but it could be more generous. It must be rolling in cash now...

Went from 5 stars to 1 overnight!! Nothing innovative about the gameplay. Same type of game like all match-3. Let's you have the first 150 or so stages for free, then they increase the level of difficulty and want you to pay to play. Becomes irritating because the game decides if you win or lose. Bit of a congested mess with all these "competitions" and pop-ups constantly bugging you. Graphics are good. That's where the 2 stars instead of 1 star rating comes from. Play it before you review.

I really got into this game. clever psychology gets you hooked in then it makes it very difficult to play for long . I think the psychological word for it is breadcrumbing as you want to be able to play . Then it all changes. Till you hardly get past one or two levels. The computer always leaving one last thing to finish game so no matter how well you play you constantly get stuck. I have now given up. such a shame was enjoying it but unless you buy stuff your on a frustrating go slow

Not often I give a 5* review. The game is just as advertised. Good fun to play. Clear, smooth graphics. No ads, and loads of freebies. You can spend money if you like, but still a great game if you don't. It's more than a match game. There's a merge game too that gives you lots of gifts. I'm just over 60 levels in. I just hope the game doesn't change as I progress and I need to spend money to go further. Worth a download folks.

Everything is OK until L592. They make you play for pink diamonds that never once show up - it's then absolutely impossible again and again regardless of you using your saved up icons/money weapons to win and see you through the hard levels I've tried it, in counting, 23 times now so no one can move forward because the game doesn't give you enough diamonds to be able to even work against. Such a shame because I loved this game for aaages as you can see.... 592 levels later... And none can move.

the most shameless money-grabbing match 3 game ever, yeh it's easy to start with, but quickly descends into a boring grind replaying the same level over and over as it constantly leaves you needing just 1 or 2 moves to finish the level. ignore the story too, game soon forgets about that. it's the worst match 3 game I have ever played. avoid it unless you have a big budget for gaming.

Fun match 3 game. Ironic the ads for the game say this isn't a fake ad game when it is, Mother and daughter skit is like about 6 levels early on only. Homebase you merge items to complete quests. Items you get from chests earned playing levels. Expect the usual, game sometimes seems to work against you in levels so need to use gems to get more moves which means buying gems. Fun extra quests and the like.

DO NOT PLAY unless you're prepared to spend money. At over level 4800, I have paid for different lands because they do not give enough space for items. they only release 3 squares of land at a time. I have not had any released for 3/4 months so star wands are useless in progressing. It also goes into honour throne far to much so you cannot collect items needed for the characters. At this level the game is extremely difficult so to be treated like this is dismal. The monthly pass is too expensive

I was really enjoying playing this game until I got past level 200. They changed the background tiles on the levels to leafy brown ones and I cannot look at them now as I have tripophobia. it has really upset me that I can no longer play. why did you have to change the tiles!! if you'd left them as they were I would probably have spent a lot of time and money continuing to play.

Like others, I downloaded this because it promised the story that was missing from other games. Initially, it delivered but after the first hundred or so levels, the story disappeared. It was as if they hadn't kept up the story development. I continued playing in the hope something would change, but eventually it just became boring and routine.

Starts off okay... and then goes downhill (boring) fast. I suppose it's good as no ads and don't need to buy anything unless you really want to (or don't mind waiting for lives to refill). It's just too samey. Think I will stick to puzzle games. Not much to think about in this one. Just match, match, match. Once you reach a certain level it's just well ... Yawn.

I never write game reviews, but this one deserves it. No ads at all. Lots of things going on and a 'generous' game with easy and hard levels giving plenty of rewards without paying money. Sure, you'll lose some lives, but it's the only way to stop the addiction! If you really want to pay, there are very cheap sale items to keep you progressing, but it's not essential. Please don't change a thing (except to add more levels).

This game has so much potential, one of best games of this type I've played. Unfortunatelly developers lost it half way through. All ideas are great. Unique boosters, lots going on at the same time, you get hooked up for a while. But then you realize there is almost zero progress. You keep playing puzzles and merging stuff but you are not actually getting anywhere. Real shames. All bells and whistles but no filling

This is a really fun game. It's a match 3 but it is combined with a merging game, which you can play as well if you want. It is in essence a free to play game, with no ads, but you can boost your gameplay with in-app purchases and offers, if you want. The levels can all be solved although some are more hard or very hard levels. Would definitely recommended it.

So far I have lost half a day! Not the sort of game I'd usually go for, but I am loving it so far. Absolutely no ads. Optional in app purchases, but not needed. No idea what, or how I'm doing things, but there are hints & guides all the way. Been looking for ages to find the right game/s and I have to say, this is the best for me! Keeps me engaged with the different games & challenges, no ads & purchases are optional. Absolutely brilliant!

1st game of this sort I've played. OK at first then becomes tedious at times, you run out of space quite quickly and you must spend money to progress. The touch screen is very sensitive when moving things around so constantly moving things you don't want to. Completing the areas is long winded and gets boring. I'll dip in and out but don't know how long for. Ad free. The prices if you choose to buy anything are as ridiculous. Whoever manages the price list is a joker 😂

Team chest problems .... again!!! New Team tournament but game is telling me to claim, so when I click I get the message that the tournament is still in progress. This has happened before, exactly the same glitch after an update. Instead of having so many things going on at once maybe just concentrate on a couple at a time, plus new levels?? So much stuff is slowing the whole game. YorkshireRose team!

Was loving the game it is very addictive. However now they have updated the game it is how taking so long to progress, they have changed some items now added more. To have to keep buying gems, the higher the levels you are the longer it takes to complete . It is now too expensive to keep purchasing gems. When I compete in the lightening hour game, I would like to know how so often the other players mange to gain 1,000 + lightening points.

It's a typical game of its type. Designed to allow you to make progress quite quickly, then it becomes more difficult without spending money on gems or coins or other extras. And the prices they want you to pay are ridiculous. If people are actually paying to make progress, then they have more money than sense. These aren't micro transactions they are gigantic transactions.

the game is ok and quite addictive. but obviously, you just get to a point where you HAVE to buy boosters to get past levels. They say you don't, but you definitely do, so that's a bit of a lie they are selling. I've tried to get past this currently level I'm on for a while now as I refuse to buy anymore gems as its become ridiculous how much I'm expected to buy just so I can pass a level. hence the 2 star rating.

I favour merge games, they're satisfying to play, but where most fall down is when you fail a level and have no boosters left, completing it becomes virtually impossible without spending real money, which as far as I'm concerned is when it's time to delete it. This game is different. If you fail a level, despite being kitted out with multiple boosters, you can try it again with none and often succeed, it's as if the difficulty level has been reduced to help. And it's constantly rewarding you.

It was great, & I played it all the time, but now they changed to some sort of 'Honor Throne', and it's just not as fun. You have to enter a separate area, and I forget to do most of the stuff on my home screen. Then you don't get as many reward chests. And the reward chests are put on your board, so you don't have any room left to organize. I miss out on the butterflies, booster boxes, free daily chest, and so much more! I just want them to go back to the regular levels and regular home screen

I was really enjoying this game and thought it was going to be my new favourite. However, on my second purchase I did not receive the items I was paying for, and customer service then ignored me when I explained there must have been an error. I didn't pay for 10,000 coins because I didn't need coins! I needed diamonds. Very upset they took my money and switched out a lower value item in my pack. I feel they are dishonest and their customer service is useless.

just removed from the phone. the advert says fed up of adverts that are nothing like the games they show? try this... its nothing like the game on the adverts, if you don't buy the third matching shaped you just end up with hundreds of pairs until you run out of space. you have to play for at least a couple of hours at a time to make any progress (when the game decides to get you win a level so you can start getting the rewards that mean you get more and more). it is addictive. BUT NO ADVERTS

I've given this game 3 stars because it is fun to play genuinely. The trouble I found is the number of squares gets to one remaining before the round ends and even if it's right under a bundle of dynamite it miraculously survives so you have to do it all again. Sometimes it is obviously impossible to finish without lots of explosions which obviously don't appear, and it relies on sheer luck and not skill.

Love the game, no ads, great. Some levels are more difficult, but unlike most other games, you don't spend days trying to clear a level. Fun to merge the items and loads of bonuses, so far so good. Unfortunately, got to level 415 and there it goes, taking days to clear levels, shame, I thought this one would be different

nothing like the ad for the game, not a puzzle in sight. yes its merging, but all you get is a bigger garden with more things to merge. BORING. I uninstalled it thinking it was downloaded wrong, but no, they welcomed me back to the old game. and as for it being free, well most of it is but they sell a lot of stuff too. stuff that would get you merged quicker.

I'm addicted! I love it (April 2024) Level 529 - 8 months down the line. I'm still religiously playing it, unfortunately the land is filling up, the rewards are slow, there's hardly any room left to put things without paying real money (which I won't do) it's a shame as it's a nice game. This being, I'm reducing my stars. If you make the rewards and merging a little quicker then we could move forward.

Too many updates. The game is OK to play. As with all merge games you have to do thousands of merges to progress. The matching games are quite well done with quite a bit of variety and the regular events are good. BUT... every time there is an update I lose access to rewards I have earned or won. I can see them there but if I try to access them it just says 'loading' and then doesn't open. It is a shame as it is spoiling the game. Think carefully before spending any money in an event.

The worst algorithm. I've played a lot of matching games but the algorithm in this one feels especially unbalanced. Power-ups rarely assist in the areas where you actually need help to win the level. Feels more like luck than strategy. It takes days to pass a level and even for levels that are not marked hard or super hard. It definitely is designed for people who would like to pay. Time to delete.

Most frustrating monetisation model I've ever seen in a game. This game unloads SO MANY in app purchases that it's mind-boggling. It's honestly hard sometimes to navigate the game world without accidentally hitting one stupid purchase offer or another, and it seems to drop in another one every thirty seconds or so. Games like this are beyond predatory, should be illegal to make something so obviously targeted at financially crippling folks who'd spend money on this garbage.

Good game but glitches let it down. Often you get enough "star dust" to complete a phase but then don't actually get the reward. It just gives you a green tick. Worst glitch however is boosters. There is no point in using them as 90% of the time they don't work. If the level you're playing has ice for example, the boosters fly at the ice and "bounce" off them and fly off the screen! You've then wasted a booster and not got the benefit of it. Really is a flaw that needs be fixed.

Absolutely love the game can't fault the idea of it at all. The only problems I have is I reached the top 401 levels to have an update that only gave 30 more levels so I've completed them too. Can't go any further even with a second update. The shadows don't clear one at a time so I've had 14 waiting to clear for the past week and can't use the star wands that are building up till they clear when I go on to the 3 island. That part is frustrating because I'm running out of space for merging now

I have uninstalled the game today. I think it took me about 20 games to win a level which doesnt even come with any items for merging, I got 1 point. Super frustrating and boring at the top level. Also different because the game is progressively being developed. At certain level you no longer have land plots for healing and have to win 20-50 points to win a case of new items. Disappointing.

Made it to level 485 but have decided to uninstall as it is taking too much real money to get through the levels. Yes it is a good game but they have craftilly made the early levels really easy to get you hooked. In later levels explosives etc drop in areas where they are of no help which is frustrating when you have items that need them on the other side of the grid.

Loved this game until level 284. Trying to pass it for 2 days. Used boosters but they have not worked like before. Using them has been a waste. The game also keeps shuffling on this level. One more day of trying this level and it will be deleted as it is not fun anymore. This is not my first bad experience. Lost 12 levels trying to sync it to another device. Lots of hard levels but the boosters normally help. Game also freezes on start up.

Honestly, one of the best games I've ever downloaded. No ads AT ALL (I actually spent 99p in game because I felt bad that I wasn't making them any money by playing), a combination of match and merge, and the levels are generally not too hard but challenging enough that they're not boring, with plenty of power-ups to help you. Thanks to the devs for such a great game <3

This is by far the best game on here, there really are no ads, just great gameplay uninterrupted. Not one of those games where you get stuck for days/weeks trying to solve just one level although it does have hard levels, you have to try, but its a fair game that helps you out eventually. This is the only game I haven't wanted to delete within days, or hours with some other similar games. Please, never change it, this game is perfect entertainment. I love it.....so far!

Dropped the game a star due to the difficulty level. When all main levels are done, you get bonus rounds which are stupid difficult and can only be completed by using your gems or bonus items. When I say difficult I mean obviously created so you can't get past them. Instead of enjoying the game, it makes you want to throw your phone across the room

I've been playing this game now for about a year. With each update, the graphics have become more fun and vibrant. I like the fact that there are no ads. It's easy to use, there's no time trials that often make me anxious. I can start a level in the morning, if I struggle and use all 5 lives, I just have to wait for a while to gain more if I haven't enough gems to buy lives. I think I'm on level 2135 as I type.
This game ceased to be fun at higher levels when you can't win 1 chest in the 5 turns & only 2 or 3 when they give you an hr. Highly addicting with high frustration levels pushing you to pay to play!

Great game, at first. But the higher the level, the more frustrating it gets. It shouldn't take 20+ attempts to solve a game. Even throwing money at the app, its becoming pointless as it can take days to complete a level. Its obviously a winning theme as the game has spawned many lookalikes. So as one app hits a wall...another one will pop up. Its a nice game, but not worth throwing your money away on. Thank you for responding to my review.

Too much merging! I really wish, for the town map page, there was a "Merge All" button. Once your village gets bigger you feel like you're spending hours matching pairs of three items and upgrading them, when all you want is space to open more chests and play more of the main game. Please add an automatic "Match All" option so we can opt to use that if we want toz as the merging takes far, far too long. Really loving the game otherwise , thousands. Thank you!

I played this game for several weeks and yes I completed all available levels, and I did,from timetable time purchase enough gems to help me on the way. However, when the game crashed and I lost the progress along with gems,boosters and points customer service were no help at all. First of all they don't read the txt you send them properly. And the 'gifts' they provide don't even come close to your loss. STOP paying to play and they might change their attitude. I have deleted now!

It's a good game, free to play, no ads, lots going on and plenty of rewards. The only reason I haven't given 5 stars is because I have found that after a certain level, the match 3 games become very difficult to complete and it gets a bit boring playing the same puzzle over and over to trying to clear the board. PS - despite some recent ads I have seen for this game, it DOES NOT feature a mother and child trying to escape from a series of dangerous situations.

I was really enjoying the game. even did a few purchases. However, for several levels now the cases are not removing once opened. There's now around 18 taking up squares. they can't be moved around board. a few landed on other items and now they're gone. Really disappointing. Don't want to play anymore - it looks bad.

So much wrong with it. Don't spend any money on this game. Once you start hitting level 350 to 400 you will normally get a level or 2 done before you run out of lives, then have to pay to carry on playing! Who in there right mind would pay just to get to next level then pay again to do that one. Very hard to move around merge board without moving the parts and tbh not entirely sure what merge part is for as doesn't really help with puzzle part. Good to start but very quickly becomes p2p.

love the game but sometimes the pieces can be difficult to merge especially the wands. The lands can get a bit crowded at times but I don't want to have to keep paying to get extra characters/pieces to make a merge, the free ones or the chance to win them don't come around often enough. The levels aren't too bad and you don't usually get stuck on them for too long.

Like some other game creators, you just get greedy! I have spent quite alot of money on this game, which is not something I would normally do. You entice players in with easy levels, but most games only inject a difficult level now and again. You on the other hand think it's perfectly acceptable to fleece players on just about every other level. To my shame I got sucked in and spent far too much money to attain levels I had played over and over again. Laughing all the way to the bank!

This is an awesome game!! Been playing for quite a while now. My only thing is now that there are "new levels" it won't give me what I need to finish getting my last character... You should be able to play the regular game, to get get your charaters, and have the choice to do the "extra" levels. Other than that I have NO complaints!

I've changed to one star because the levels are ridiculous! And not everyone can buy the boosters & you're making a fortune. On 997 & its now too hard. Difficulty of some levals not labled 'hard' or 'super hard' are so much harder than 'easy' ones. The game instructions & tips say it's possible to win without boosters & diamonds. It's taken me over a week to win some levels, so I don't agree with that statement. I requested to have my account deleted.

No ads. It's difficult finding fun mobile games without ads or without ads every level like most games now. I've been playing this game for some months now. Thank you! For real, I just want to pay games to relax, and I can't relax if I have to keep clicking off ads or accidentally hitting buttons from ads. *Chefs kiss*

update! after playing for two years I've pretty much given up. it's almost impossible without constantly buying gems 😭 and waiting for new land over and over is boring 😞 great game 😁 challenging for sure and I run out of Pu all the time but it's fun. customer service fixed my issue with the team finding button in time before I bailed. prices are reasonable so thanks for that. worth the download 😄

I like this game. I downloaded it to give it a try. I understand levels get harder but I be stuck on levels for days very frustrating. Someone posted that when you get stuck on a hard levels it does not last long. There wrong. And when win prizes we do not get enough diamonds. I like it but Im deleting this game I use to much boosters constantly. J. 25

Enjoyable game. Im hoping this GREAT game will not end up disappointing me as so many others have. Right now It has proven worthy. The graphics R colorful & the Free gifts and boosters are continuous. Though the concept isn't new there are enough differences to keep you engaged. I MUST WARN YOU! If YOU'RE Playing during your break at work or while stuck in traffic, YOU WILL miss the opportunity to change your lane and you will most definitely not make it back to work on time!!! Enjoy!

Great game, has events going all the time, UT I will say this lvl 1-100 freelancing easy to place even win some events aftertaste it starts to get but ot impossible due to chances of scoring free item boosters. yes, there are ways to pay to make your game easier, but you really don't need it, just perseverance and jion a team if to ask for and help others for hearts and lootz in comps. playing solo or in a group the game caters for all downside is lack of space. plus screen clutter.as u will c.

Having played only 11 levels so far I can see this is a relaxing, colorful and pleasant game. Lovely graphics, soothing sounds and clear instructions make this a pleasure to play. The story is interesting and purchases don't seem absolutely required to continue. After more levels I'll share any new findings.

ads are misleading, I've only seen the lady a handful of times and I've been playing for over 8 months. after a few times, I haven't seen her for over 7 months, in addition I never saw the little girl or the scenarios shown in the add. In addition the game is expensive, if you want to enjoy the game you end of spending a lot of money. I plan on deleting

Excellent graphics, match 3 game with merging. Levels get progressively harder - if you fail you need 900 gems to pass, which gets expensive. Not recommended for children with limited pocket money or people with gambling issues. A pay to win game. No ads and you can play competitively with other players, but the game is designed for you to win a games then lose more so you need to keep buying gems. It would be good if you could convert earned gold coins into gems but this is not available.

This game was great.....for awhile. I invested a lot of time and hard work into this game over a long period of time. Then I got to levels over 1,000 and just got tired of paying and using multiple boosters EVERY SINGLE LEVEL. It got exhausting, even regular levels require boosters and buying more moves. I can't play any events because I just can't win ANY levels, none, without help. So I finally uninstalled it due to difficulty. Sad because I really did enjoy the game.

Fun merge game. No ads. This is probably the best thing about this game. Uninterrupted play. Very rare to find. Still playing. I'm a little disappointed in some of their side games/events. Like many games you collect cards to win prizes. Difficult to complete collections. I spend money on the game, play frequently and often do not collect all the cards. The regular levels seem to be more difficult also.

No ads which is nice. It starts off fun, then as you progress they give you less of the pieces you need, but hey if you spend money you can get them, or keep your win streak going. Now it's just failing constantly, and progressing SO SLOW it's hardly even worth it. This game is a play for a couple days then delete. Don't waste any money, no matter what you spend it's never enough.

This game combines many things in one game, matching, building, and goals. There are beautiful graphics. There's also many ways to earn extra time and resources, so you don't always have to spend money to proceed. Thanks for a very fun and addictive game. The only thing now is there are misleading ads for the game, like matches to "save" whomever. Consider changing those ads, especially if people are looking for the game being advertised.

In that last honor thrown, the #1 place was supposed to get 5000 diamonds and 60 boards., I only received 3000 diamonds. I have notices the game issues in other areas. Such as a match that should give you a bomb and you only get and arrow, this is usually after you have not lost in a while. I have put some money into this game. I think I am done now.

This is the most enjoyable, sweetest, and fun game I've ever played! I absolutely adore all the little characters; healing the various themed lands, and playing to earn the next iteration of flowers, plants, garden adornments, and especially animals! The found this game to "play fair;" meaning it doesn't gouge me every two minutes to buy something (Disney Solitaire should take this lesson!) and doesn't inhibit my ability to progress in the game or strip me of all my treasure if I lose a level.

Liars. I downloaded thru the link in the app and opened to play immediately from the link here in Google Play on the page the ad sent me to. The ad claimed it was the real one, to rescue the mom and daughter with no in-app purchases. There is no distraught mom and daughter, but there IS an in-app purchase shop. You have to play a few rounds of the fairy farming match-3 game you do get before the shop opens. Then you get a newcomers package offer for $1.99. 3 stars for ease of play.

The game is good in the beginning, relaxing easy passing levels.. i got to level 2400+ and it's just started to be unplayable, just can't pass more then 3 levels in a row unless you spend money or gems(and you can't earn gems if you don't pass levels and win in competition) A few times i bought that monthly ticket and it does help cause you have more moves but eventually the game will do everything for you to spend more money. It came to a point I'm more frustrated than enjoying playing.

It would probably be a fun game to play if you could actually but it takes so dreadfully long to move to the next level because the game shows you the same stinking benefits over and over and over. What do you expect me to do? Sit and wait for every hair on my head to turn gray? I've managed to get through 9 levels and I'm deleting the game.

My one and only thing that upsets 😡 me is there isn't any storage for your items . I don't like that the items doesn't go to their climate area for instance if it's a polar bear when it scattering it should end up in the snow. I love the game but I hate how cluttered my home area is because you can't organize anything without storage. I think this would be a good idea or when you pay for the fairy she puts things in the correct area. I paid for the extra land but it's super full. Please fix it

Love, Love, love this game!!! I love that I can click through all of the collections and gifts. I don't have to set and watch the reveal of everything I've collected. my only complaint is the popping up of the helicopters. they're always in the way and when you try to move them you have to drag them away off into new areas and they'll still bounce back into place if you don't move them far enough.

Just like many merge games. Maybe a bit better than most, but so many side elements that it's kind of overwhelming with the amount of non-merge junk that it becomes a bit irritating. I'm not actually sure what the actual game is anymore. Can't make progress with the merging because of all the side stuff that's 100% unrelated to the game.

A new update has introduced "extremely hard" levels. What the game actually needed was *easier* play, not harder?! That's it, I'm done... I wont be playing this game again because its just too frustrating and impossible to progress. Stupid change by making it harder to play.

I have played other matching merge games before And did not like them. but I I love this game some levels are easy. some levels are very hard but it's really fun and I get excited when I win a level it would be nice if we can use boosters during the game.

You're very stingy with the power ups and helps too! It takes almost an act of God to get any! I'm getting bored because I can't progress. If I can't keep playing bc I can't progress, I'll just quit playing and go find another game where I can! Seems you'd want people to keep playing your game, not leave it.

Game has been a lot of fun with many different side events and challenges. I have been saving my treasure chests to open and I have reached level 450 in the puzzle match. So frustrating. I have shut down and restarted my phone, and made sure the app is up to date. Still, no changes.

I absolutely hate this game!! This game was fun at first until you get to the higher levels. Then you have to spend money to get past a level. Also, when you run out of lives you need 900 diamonds to get a lousy 5 lives. Once those are gone, it jumps up by a 1000 every time for another 5 lives. Plus when you think you've cleared tiles, there are more obstacles underneath. Don't waste your time with this game!!

this is a mostly fun game. after the first 200 levels, though, it consistently tries to get you to make in-game purchases. a lot. the game seems to forget all about the early merge items you get, so your board is full of moot pieces, and the gold coins you get can't purchase any of them either. it's impossible almost to get any of the game boosters without an in-game purchase, or 'joining' a team. it is fun, but would be more fun if you could merge items easier and faster, with gold coins.

I don't recommend this game. The game itself is great, graphics are lovely, story was fun, but if you reach the upper levels, suddenly the game changes an its almost impossible to play without spending regular money. Font get me wrong, I have no issue with spending from time to time , but I feel like the level I'm at isn't winnable without purchasing. So, I'm done with it. I feel like I've been screwed.

Very nice game. I enjou the merging and building plots, but too expensive. When you get to the higher levels it's just impossible to win a level without buying "diamonds" unless you play the same level 10 times, then suddenly the system gives you enough help to finish that level. By that time you just give up and wait for the next day to be able to play again. It is very frustrating unless you have enough money to buy extras in every level.

I really like this game. It makes it more exciting to have two of my favorite games in one. That being said, I do have concerns. I know that this is an early roll-out but some glitches need to be addressed. Three times I have had gems taken but no extra moves granted. I had gems not given when a goal was achieved. I have no problem purchasing extra gems but it feels like I'm being forced to do so. I will also not watch an ad because those free moves were not granted. I hope you can fix this.

The Match 3 portion of the game is fine, if a bit generic for the genre. The merge portion is chaotic, especially once you start getting so many things that need merging. But the big dealbreakers are all the side events that come up, leaving the merge screen cluttered with so many buttons (16 at last check) and the constant push to spend money in the cash shop to unlock X, Y, or Z. Not a very fun experience, would not recommend.

I really liked this game, at first. I played all the time and was able to pass most levels the first or second time, until I made my first diamond purchase. After that most levels took all 5 lives more than once. I received an hour of free lives, I spent the entire hour trying to pass just 1 level. Because I liked the game so much I made 2 more small purchases, and have still been stuck on this level for a week. you're a rip-off I'm deleting the game. DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME!!!!!!

Game started out good, however, I quickly started noticing problems. Merging 3 items together, I am credited with the correct next item. When merging 5 of the same item, I'm not receiving the bonus second item. Another frustrating point is the moving of items on the board is difficult. Items stick, or wrong items move. I have played many other similar games to this one, they do not have this problem.

Compared to others it's pretty great. All games monetize, but this one doesn't do it as intrusively. It's the only game I haven't deleted after a few days. It doesn't force ads either. It does get difficult after level 200 or so. Without purchasing aid, it's tough. However, I've played almost all the similar games, both merge and match 3, and this one is the best.

DO NOT PURCHASE JEWELS!!! This game freaking sucks! I loved this game, so the last 2 weekends, I purchased 24,000 jewels for $17 and 22,000 jewels for $11, so I could play and play. Only problem is, when Friday rolls around, and the new great offer is available, their algorithms make it impossible for me to beat an easy level. Why?? So I use up all my jewels and have to purchase more! Don't be a sucker like me!!!

A very generous 2 stars because it is admittedly fun and addictive early on. But after the first thousand or so levels, the difficulty ramps up to the point that you literally can't progress without spending money on items or lives. If you do manage to beat all available levels, it sends you to the "Honor Throne" tournament, which is even harder but offers even fewer rewards. Also, the ads are deceptive; the game looks nothing like you see advertised. Shameless cash grab bordering on scam.

Like the combination of Match-3, Merge, & collection. No ads, very few pop us, all modes work well. Gold Ticket too expensive. Merge combos don't work very well. no matter placement, items combine into furthest possible space instead of next to existing item(s) of the next level. Results in only getting 1 combo at a time when 2-plus should be possible. Also, too many pieces that just sit on the board as you wait & wonder how/when you'll get enough pieces to clear them from the map

It's a cool game.. But.... Way, Way too many things on home screen. They either need to remove some (if not all) of the purchasing offers or limit the side games. Space to store everything that needs to be completed is also too small, I now have like 12 to 15 items Im trying to complete in an area the size of a thumbnail. It's very crowded, and with poor eyesight, it's hard to see what's what and what needs to be matched or move things around.

I love this game and play every day and I do make purchases. The problem is...it punishes loyal players. If you've gone through all the levels, you have to wait 2 weeks for more levels and play something called Honor Throne where you have to play up to 60 games to get a single chest. They should leave it at 10 or fewer games to get a chest. When I'm having to do this, it definitely tempts me to move on to a similar game. The creators need to not penalize loyal players!!

The ad where the guy says that this game actually has the story of the woman and daughter is completely false. There's an occasional side "bonus" level where you have to fix a room up but it's also nothing like the ad. Otherwise it's not a great game. Just a mashup of other better games. No ads but eventually you'll need to spend money to advance. If that's what you're into, then you'll probably love it.

Puzzle games have solutions. This "game" is designed so that you run out of moves every level with one more needed to finish the level, which you can buy for an exorbitant amount of game currency you have to pay for with real money. It's not random or chance, but a rigged means of baiting you into spending money, disguised as a puzzle game.

I like the game but will be uninstalling due to 2 factors, when a balloon or other item pops up for a sale you can't get rid of it and it's always in the way. ( there was 3 taking up space right now) the second factor is you can't get rid of the hints or instructions, they play over and over each game, this gets monotonous after a couple of levels.

It's a money grab game. Not as it was advertised. You get stuck on a level missing that level by 1 item in order to make you buy boosters. And according to review answers its constantly stated you can buy but don't have to. It's frustrating to wait a days or longer to finally pass a level. Not to mention the merging mess and constant pop up sales balloons. Ppl don't wanna spend hard earned money, especially when they need groceries and keep a roof over their head. Do not recommend this game.

As seems to be typical of recent match/merge games, the ads don't represent normal gameplay. This game, though, is just weird. The main "plot" involves fantasy characters, but the between-level challenges feature a modern single mother character and her derelict house that you click to clean up and decorate. There are also the themed cards, whose function I never did figure out, but the one for "Pesticides" convinced me to uninstall the game.

It used to be a good game. But they are very slow to increase the size of the land to develop. Also, the power ups are as powerful as they used to be. Without spending money, it is very hard to progress in this game. It takes forever to finish their characters. They don't add new levels quickly enough, and when they do, they do not add many new levels. They take you to Honor Throne and get the chests take forever. Some of them 30+ wins to get a chest with a few little items in it.

on level 512 and haven't paid for anything. I could spend money on special lands and discount items I've just chosen to see how far I can go without paying. I love the game it like 5 mini games built into the one big game. I notice someone complained about the ballons that pop up with items on sale if you don't like them just left click and hold and move them out of the way. Plenty of chances for for coins, diamonds and lives. Highly recommend.

This game used to be fun. It has now joined the rest of the other matching games with its predatory actions. Easy levels require several attempts to complete. Hard levels require several hours to complete. Super Hard levels require several days to complete. But hey! Spend real money and you can bypass all of that. Remember when games like this were fun and an enjoyable time waste while being free? Pepperidge Farm remembers.

I'm at level 3449 now and so far I'm enjoying this game. No ads at all, and there are bunch of quests to earn rewards and booster to help you win levels. I like a match three game that can be challenging at times and this is one of it. I've been beating levels without spending a dime, but now the levels are harder and I've been repeating some levels which dries up my boosters & diamonds, and sometimes I have no choice but to spend some money just to get out of that level. Got me good.

This game is a blatant, greedy money grab. All match games are like this, but this is by far the worst. They will set it up so that your last turn you almost win, to try to force you into buying gems, but when every single level is like that, you're either spending hundreds of $$ or hours on a single level. It robs the game of any enjoyment. when you can make progress, it's a fun enough game, but the greed turned out into a nightmare slog.

huge player on match kingdom came over. lots to improve on. Fun game, at first. Then suddenly you can't pass levels without $$$. And they make you update every 5 minutes and then the game doesn't work. I decided to update. The game has improved. this game is so much fun and can keep you busy for hours. it is a little addictive

the game that I have is pretty good, but there's no lame lady and kid that can't find a homeless shelter in the dead of winter. it's a match3 merge game with optional in game purchases, lots of side games, and lots of levels. no ads. don't know if it requires wifi to play. would have given it 4 or 5 stars, but took off for false advertising.

Nice game for a while, but obviously designed to get you to eventually pay to retain or gain bonuses without which levels become impossible to pass. I think when it's setting off other things, sometimes it counts against me.

You'll need them! 900 diamonds to continue playing with only 5 moves is ridiculous. it takes a long time to build them back up, as the payout from passing levels is minimal. otherwise, it's fun

Fun. I tried this game based on the ad, to see if the claims were true. 1-no ads. TRUE! 2-no wifi. Haven't tested. 3-no pay to play through levels. LIE! Granted, it is easier to go through if you don't care, but when the ads say you don't have to pay, they shouldn't have anything that you have to buy. Be alert to this and you will be fine. Other than that, it's a good, fun game.

Great game, very addictive, no ads, just a very cool and peaceful game to play. I never thought I'd say such a statement, but, I must! I love it. Semi-fun game with several flaws. One of the better match-3 games out there. Other than that, I'm really enjoying the game.
